reason: The cited evidence (E1) directly supports all key premises: it shows that serrated grain boundaries, achieved by slower cooling, resolved hot ductility drop by distributing strain more evenly, with the exact improvement factors cited. premises: Serrated grain boundaries improve toughness by distributing strain more evenly and mitigating intergranular crack initiation.
Serrated grain boundaries can be achieved by reducing the cooling rate during solution heat treatment.
The mechanism involves serrated boundaries disrupting strain localization and reducing local stress concentration.
The effect is demonstrated in a high-entropy alloy processed by selective laser melting, tested at 650°C.
The predicted improvement factors (~3.5× fracture strain, ~400× creep life) are based on prior work.
